cards.title: Moon Muffin Paper Sleeve Counter Sentences
cards.sentenceVarietySkill: turn one tiny market idea into short, stretched, question, and combined sentence choices
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper sleeve sentence-variety card for trying several fictional moon muffin market sentence shapes on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place this paper card beside blank paper and choose one invented moon muffin counter idea to reshape: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: Try the same tiny market idea as a short line, a longer line, a question, and a final smooth line: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: Add where, when, or how the moon muffin tray glowed at the counter: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: Ask what the helper noticed about the glowing tray: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Opening swap: Begin with At the counter, With one soft glow, or Under the paper awning: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: Join The tray glowed and The helper smiled with and, so, or because: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: Read the short line and the stretched line on paper, then mark the smoother one: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: Choose the best moon muffin sentence shape and write it clearly: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to one favorite sentence shape, then write only the final line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later line: Try the same sentence shapes with a pretend crumb card or silver wrapper: ____________________.
